description: This file defines a custom exception class CollateralNotFoundException indicating a specific error condition when collateral is not found, extending a platform-specific exception.

classes.name: CollateralNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating that collateral with a specific identifier does not exist, extending a generic resource-not-found exception.

methods.name: CollateralNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error message key, a detailed message including the collateral ID, and the ID itself.

calls: super("error.msg.collateral.id.invalid", "Collateral with identifier " + id + " does not exist", id)
